function: CNN regression predicts UAV-RIS 3D position, number of RIS elements, and primary/secondary transmit powers maximizing covert-user throughput under outage and detection-error constraints (pp. 8-10)
system: Reflecting UAV-RIS relay (N=3, 5, 7 elements) in CR-NOMA with UAV warden and jammer; single-antenna nodes; 1 MHz bandwidth; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 11)
method: Supervised CNN regression on the outer product of 16 environment parameters (3 conv layers, 355,718 parameters); labels from CGA, PSO, BAO optimizers; transformer also trained (pp. 9-10)
data_channel: Custom Monte-Carlo model: Rayleigh ground-to-ground, Nakagami-m (m=2) air-ground links with LoS/NLoS path loss, imperfect CSI; 10,000 random environment samples, labels by optimizers (pp. 4-5, 11, 13)
test_conditions: Environment parameters drawn uniformly at random in fixed ranges; 8,000 pairs for training, 2,000 held-out pairs of the same distribution for testing; no extrapolation tested (pp. 9, 13)
baselines: Non-learned: CGA, PSO, BAO optimizers (throughput gap and runtime); learned: transformer network on the same task (testing MSE, throughput percentage) (pp. 13-14)
metrics: Training and test MSE, mean objective-value (throughput) percentage versus the optimizer, training/test/prediction time; covert-system metrics: detection error probability, outage probability, covert throughput (pp. 11-14)
complexity: CNN 355,718 trainable parameters (1.36 MB), transformer 393,654; CNN training 318 s, prediction 0.567 ms per sample versus 6.8-7.6 s per optimization run (pp. 10, 13-14)
q1_support: p. 4: "the channel gains follow a Rayleigh fading model"; p. 5: "communication follow a Nakagami-m" - custom Rayleigh and Nakagami-m models with path loss from cited UAV papers [59], [60]; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 13: "pairs are reserved as unseen data for later evaluation of the" - a held-out 20% of the same random data; p. 9: "that the DNN does not have to perform extrapolation for" - no new scenario or range is tested.
q3_support: p. 14: "99.04% of the optimized throughput" (CNN with CGA labels; PSO 99.12%, BAO 99.30%) compares with the non-learned optimizers; p. 14: "data is high, reaching 99.38% when the transformer" is the learned comparison (CNN 99.67%, Table 2 on p. 13).
q4_support: p. 10: "parameters is 355718, which requires 1.36 MB of memory" (CNN size; transformer 393,654); p. 14: "0.567 ms, which can be considered a real-time response" (measured prediction time).
q5_support: p. 13: "we generate 10,000 uniformly" random samples from the authors' own model; no code or data link, no public dataset, and no availability statement appears in the paper.
notes: Included, area 6, borderline: the CNN predicts the primary and secondary transmit powers, the number of RIS elements and the UAV-RIS 3D position for an aerial relay link, so a power decision is learned jointly with the placement (aerial-link rule); the covert-communication objective is not itself one of the seven areas. Table 2 was read from the page image (p. 13). CGA, PSO and BAO also generate the training labels, and the only learned comparison is a transformer trained on the same data. The RIS phase shifts are not learned.
